name: ClaimLand
summary:
ClaimLand is a location-based multiplayer game played on a real-world map. The Earth's land surface is divided into a grid of plots of roughly 30 by 30 meters, and players can only visit and buy the plots near their actual GPS position, plus a wider outer ring at higher levels. Owned plots earn in-game gold every minute, and other players can buy them away at a price that rises with every sale. Players level up from 1 to 40, build on their land in five stages from a tent to a castle, and compete on worldwide and per-country leaderboards.

Players can join alliances of up to five members, place Co-Claims on their allies' plots, pool gold and diamonds in a shared alliance bank and raise the alliance's level; alliance members cannot buy plots from each other. The game is free to play with optional rewarded video ads. The Android version offers optional in-app purchases: day passes that grant the ad rewards without watching the videos, a cosmetic plot skin and a tip for the developer. Plots, buildings and ranks cannot be bought, and in-game currency cannot be cashed out.
